checker_notes: q4 is a brief item, but its key adds '(a hash of it)'. The brief only says users are chosen by user ID so each user is always in or always out. Drop the hash detail from the key, or say any deterministic function of the user ID counts.

q9 asks only what happens when the shadow side cannot keep up, but its key also needs 'failed shadow inferences are logged as errors and not retried', which is a different failure. Either widen the question to cover shadow inference failures, or remove that clause from the key so a correct overload-only answer is not marked incomplete.
